rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something common or found widely.

example.traditional: 依家智能手機已經好普遍喇。
example.jyutping: ji1 gaa1 zi3 nang4 sau2 gei1 ji5 ging1 hou2 pou2 pin3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a broad range or distribution, especially of beliefs, discussion, or activity.

example.english: This study led to widespread discussion.
example.traditional: 呢項研究引起咗廣泛討論。
example.jyutping: nei1 hong6 jin4 gau3 jan5 hei2 zo2 gwong2 faan6 tou2 leon6

rows.note: Use this for things spread literally all over a physical area.

example.english: After the downpour, puddles were widespread throughout the streets.
example.traditional: 大雨過後，街上遍地都係積水。
example.jyutping: daai6 jyu5 gwo3 hau6 gaai1 soeng6 pin3 dei6 dou1 hai6 zik1 seoi2
